title: De tre mostrene
world: Present-day Norway. The girl grew up in a small, bare log cabin deep in the forest with her father, a hunter, and a chest freezer full of moose. The Palace is big and pale, with a side wing of small staff rooms, cool corridors, a staff canteen and a Great Hall. The Queen grew flax in the Palace Park: pale-gold fibre in big sacks; spun, it becomes fine pale-gold yarn on spools; woven, fine cloth with a blue pattern; sewn, twelve white shirts. Her new spinning machine is a boxy gadget with knobs, spools and a little panel of lamps. The loom is a huge, dark wooden museum piece from the 1700s. The cook wears a white jacket, and the butler a black tailcoat.
palette: Cool, clean palace whites and pale greys in spring, with soft lamp light in small side-wing rooms at night and bright morning sun on new cloth, then a summer wedding of white tablecloths and white flowers under chandeliers, lit by the harsh white pop of camera flashes. At the start, the dim brown interior of a forest cabin. Accents: flax gold, a woven blue pattern and the Queen's rainbow-striped knitting.

cast.name: Jenta (den nye assistenten)
cast.description: En fattig manns datter som får jobb i Slottets husholdning, blir presset til å levere håndarbeid hun ikke kan, og ender som brud mens hun bærer på en hemmelig avtale.
cast.look: A slim, cheerful girl of seventeen with an oval face dusted all over with freckles, a snub nose, big hazel eyes, a wide smile and mousy-brown hair in one thick plait over her shoulder, with a blue jay feather tucked behind one ear. She wears a pine-green knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up, black trousers, a grey work apron with a small blank name badge and sturdy brown boots.
cast.portrait: Background: a small staff room in the Palace side wing at night.

cast.name: Bruden
cast.description: Jenta på bryllupsdagen. Hedersdagen er kommet, og nå husker hun hva hun har lovet de tre gamle damene.
cast.look: A slim young bride of eighteen with an oval face dusted with freckles, a snub nose, big hazel eyes and a wide smile, her mousy-brown hair in one thick plait woven with small white flowers and a blue jay feather. She wears a simple, elegant ivory silk wedding dress with long lace sleeves and a small, delicate diamond tiara.
cast.portrait: Background: the Great Hall with white flowers.

cast.name: Dronningen
cast.description: Velvillig, men lett påvirkelig leder av Slottet som elsker tradisjonelt håndarbeid og lar seg overbevise av rykter og «bevis» på talent.
cast.look: A tall, willowy, kindly queen of about fifty-five with a long neck, a long oval face, crinkly grey eyes, a slightly long nose and dark hair streaked with silver in a low, coiled knot. She wears a sea-green wool dress with a cream lace collar, pearl earrings and a long rainbow-striped hand-knitted scarf, and she is always knitting: two long wooden needles, a half-finished striped scarf and a ball of pink yarn.
cast.portrait: Background: a bright palace sitting room with a basket of yarn.

cast.name: Prinsen
cast.description: En moderne prins som liker jentas ekte væremåte, men blir rystet når «mostrene» avslører prisen av arbeidet og tvinger ham til å ta et tydelig standpunkt.
cast.look: A tall, slender, polite young man of about twenty-two who blushes easily, with a long, clean-shaven face, a dimpled chin, a long nose with a little bump, earnest dark eyes under thick eyebrows and short, tidy black curls. He wears a deep-teal wool blazer over a white shirt, charcoal trousers and tan suede boots.

cast.name: Mosteren med den lange nesa
cast.description: Den første gamle damen, som spinner alt linet på én natt. Hun har sittet over rokken og nikket og nikket i alle år, og nå er nesa så lang at fotografene tror det er en maske.
cast.look: A small, hunched old woman of about eighty with a kindly, wrinkled face, sharp, merry little blue eyes, rosy cheeks and an enormous nose, thick as a cucumber at the root and so long that it looks like a carnival mask, ending in a round pink tip. Her white hair is in a small knot. She wears a long moss-green hooded cloak that looks sewn from old velvet curtains, leans on a crooked walking stick, and a black raven rides on her shoulder.
cast.portrait: Background: a half-open door in a dark palace corridor.

cast.name: Mosteren med den brede baken
cast.description: Den andre gamle damen, som vever alt garnet på én natt. Hun har skubbet seg fram og tilbake på vevbenken siden hun var ung, og nå må hun gå sidelengs gjennom dobbeltdører.
cast.look: A short old woman of about eighty with narrow shoulders, a small round head and enormously broad hips and backside, so wide that she has to turn sideways to get through a double door. She has a square little face, a snub nose, bright squinting eyes, a gap-toothed grin and grey hair in a tight bun under a small round black felt hat. She wears a huge, bell-shaped skirt with wide red and ochre stripes, a white blouse and a short dark-brown cardigan.
cast.portrait: Background: a huge old wooden loom.

cast.name: Mosteren med de røde øynene
cast.description: Den tredje gamle damen, som syr tolv skjorter på én natt. Hun har stirret og sydd natt og dag siden hun var lita, og ingen briller hjelper lenger.
cast.look: A round-shouldered old woman of about eighty, of middle height, with a soft, wrinkled face and thick glasses with round red frames, behind which her eyes look as big as plates, red-rimmed and always running with tears. Her silver hair is braided and pinned in a ring on top of her head. She wears a dusty-rose dress with a white collar, a red tomato-shaped pincushion on her wrist and a silver thimble on one finger.
cast.portrait: Background: a sewing machine under a lamp.

cast.name: Husøkonomen
cast.description: Husøkonomen har jobbet på Slottet i elleve år og blir fortsatt kalt Berit, selv om hun ikke heter det. Sammen med kokken og hovmesteren finner hun på løgn etter løgn om den nye.
cast.look: A thin, stiff, tight-lipped woman of about fifty with a narrow, pinched face, pale eyebrows, a sharp little nose, cold pale-blue eyes and ash-blonde hair scraped back into a hard bun. She wears a navy staff uniform dress with a white collar and a small blank name badge, a big bunch of keys at her belt, and carries a clipboard.
cast.portrait: Background: the staff canteen of the Palace.

places.name: the Royal Sitting Room
places.look: A bright, elegant sitting room in the Palace, with pale-grey walls, tall windows onto the park, a soft green armchair by a marble fireplace, a small round table, a big basket of yarn and knitting on the floor, and a parquet floor with a faded rug.

places.name: the Great Hall
places.look: The Palace's great banqueting hall: tall white walls with gilded mouldings, crystal chandeliers, long tables with white tablecloths, white flowers, silver cutlery and gold chairs, tall double doors at one end, and a red rope along one wall where the press stands.

cover.prompt: Night in the side wing of the Palace, one room crammed with work. The Girl sleeps on a camp bed in the middle, still in her apron. Around her the three aunts are hard at work: the Long-Nosed Aunt at a boxy spinning machine with blinking lamps, her enormous nose nodding over the yarn and the raven on her shoulder; the Broad-Hipped Aunt at a huge old wooden loom, shoving back and forth on its bench; and the Teary-Eyed Aunt at a sewing machine, stitching a white shirt.
cover.caption: Tre gamle damer spinner, vever og syr, mens den nye assistenten sover.
cover.alt: Jenta sover på ei feltseng, og rundt henne jobber tre gamle damer: én med kjempelang nese og en ravn på skulderen spinner, én med kjempebred bak vever, og én med tykke røde briller syr.

illustrations.prompt: Inside a small, bare log cabin deep in the forest, lit by a single bulb: a chest freezer hums in the corner, and a pair of moose antlers hangs on the wall. The Girl, without her apron, sits at the table plucking a grouse into a bucket, feathers everywhere. Her father, a lean, weather-beaten hunter with grey stubble in an orange cap and a worn camouflage jacket, leans in the doorway and looks at her thoughtfully.
illustrations.caption: «Jeg har jo ikke lært deg annet enn å ribbe ryper og steke dem.»
illustrations.alt: Jenta sitter ved bordet i ei enkel hytte og ribber ei rype, med fjær overalt. Faren, en mager jeger med oransje lue, står i døra og ser tenksomt på henne.

illustrations.anchor: Dronningen lyste opp og sendte bud etter jenta.
illustrations.prompt: The Royal Sitting Room. The Queen sits in the green armchair with her knitting and lights up, beaming at the Girl, who has just been sent for and stands before her in her apron, startled. Behind the armchair stands the Housekeeper with her arms folded and a thin smile, and behind her a cook in a white jacket and a butler in a black tailcoat look on smugly.
illustrations.caption: «Har du sagt det, så skal du gjøre det», sa dronningen.
illustrations.alt: Dronningen sitter med strikketøyet og stråler mot jenta, som står forskrekket foran henne. Bak stolen står husøkonomen med armene i kors, og bak henne kokken og hovmesteren.

illustrations.prompt: Two o'clock at night in a small staff room in the side wing of the Palace, lit by one lamp. The Girl sits on the edge of her narrow bed with her phone in her hand and tears on her cheeks. Beside her stand a big sack of flax and a brand-new royal spinning machine, a boxy thing with knobs, spools and a little panel of lamps, like a coffee machine. The door has creaked open a crack, and in the gap stands the Long-Nosed Aunt, hunched, her enormous nose poking into the room, looking at the Girl with sharp, bright eyes.
illustrations.caption: «Er du fra renholdet?» spurte jenta.
illustrations.alt: Jenta sitter på sengekanten om natta med mobilen i hånda og gråter ved siden av en rar spinnemaskin med knotter og lamper. I døråpningen står en krokrygget gammel dame med en kjempelang nese.

illustrations.anchor: Dronningen holdt en snelle opp mot lyset.
illustrations.prompt: A bright morning in the Royal Sitting Room. The Queen holds a spool of fine, even, pale-gold yarn up to the light of the tall window and gazes at it in wonder, with more spools in a basket at her feet, while the Girl stands beside her in her apron, cheeks pink. In the doorway, the Housekeeper watches with a face like thunder, clutching her clipboard.
illustrations.caption: «Dette», sa hun, «er det vakreste garnet jeg har sett.»
illustrations.alt: Dronningen holder en snelle med fint, jevnt garn opp mot lyset og ser forundret på den. Jenta står rød i kinnene ved siden av, og i døra står husøkonomen og ser sur ut.

illustrations.anchor: Jenta satt på en feltseng og så på vevstolen
illustrations.prompt: Night in a bare workroom in the Palace. In the middle stands a huge, dark wooden loom from the 1700s, a museum piece, with a velvet rope and a small blank sign on a stand beside it. The Girl, in her apron, sits hunched on a narrow camp bed facing it, hugging her knees, tears running down her freckled cheeks, and the loom seems to look back at her. One lamp, a dark window.
illustrations.caption: Jenta satt på en feltseng og så på vevstolen, og vevstolen så på henne.
illustrations.alt: Midt i et nakent rom står en diger, gammel vevstol av mørkt tre. Jenta sitter på en feltseng foran den med armene rundt knærne og gråter.

illustrations.anchor: Hun våknet av at sola sto rett inn gjennom vinduet.
illustrations.prompt: Morning sun pours in through the window of the bare workroom. The huge old loom stands empty and still. On the table lies a length of new cloth, folded with sharp edges, tight and even, woven with a fine blue pattern. The Girl stands before it in her apron with her mouth open and both hands pressed to her chest, relieved and a little frightened.
illustrations.caption: På bordet lå stoffet, tett og jevnt og med et blått mønster.
illustrations.alt: Morgensola skinner inn i rommet. Vevstolen står tom, og på bordet ligger et brettet stoff med et fint, blått mønster. Jenta står med åpen munn og hendene mot brystet.

illustrations.prompt: The Royal Sitting Room. On the round table lie twelve white shirts, ironed, folded and buttoned right up to the neck. The Queen claps her hands in delight, her knitting tucked under one arm, and beams at the Girl, who stands beside the shirts in her apron, looking down. In the doorway stands the Prince, blushing red right up to his hair, one hand half raised as if to stop his mother.
illustrations.caption: Prinsen sto i døra. Han ble rød helt opp i håret. «Mamma», sa han.
illustrations.alt: Dronningen klapper i hendene over tolv hvite skjorter på bordet, og jenta står ved siden av og ser ned. I døra står prinsen, rød helt opp i håret.

illustrations.anchor: «God dag, moster!» sa hun, høyt nok til at alle hørte det.
illustrations.prompt: The wedding dinner in the Great Hall, with the press lined up behind the red rope along the wall. The tall double doors stand open, and in them stands the Long-Nosed Aunt in her green hooded cloak, leaning on her stick with the raven on her shoulder, her enormous nose reaching far into the hall. The Bride has risen from her seat beside the Prince and curtsies deeply to her with a smile, while two bodyguards in dark suits glance at each other.
illustrations.caption: «God dag, moster!» sa hun, høyt nok til at alle hørte det.
illustrations.alt: I bryllupssalen står en gammel kvinne i grønn kappe med en ravn på skulderen og en kjempelang nese i døra. Bruden reiser seg og neier dypt, og to livvakter ser på hverandre.

illustrations.anchor: Hun hadde nesten ikke fått satt seg før den tredje kom.
illustrations.prompt: In the Great Hall, the Teary-Eyed Aunt arrives at the wedding table in her thick red-framed glasses, wiping her huge, streaming eyes with a napkin snatched from the nearest table. Already seated are the Long-Nosed Aunt, her raven perched on the back of her chair studying the silverware, and the Broad-Hipped Aunt, sitting on two chairs pushed tight together. The Bride rises for the third time, and the Prince smiles stiffly towards the cameras.
illustrations.caption: Bak glassene var øynene store som tallerkener, røde og rennende.
illustrations.alt: En tredje gammel kvinne med tykke briller og store, røde og rennende øyne tørker seg med en serviett. Ved bordet sitter mosteren med ravnen og mosteren som trenger to stoler. Bruden reiser seg igjen.

illustrations.anchor: Journalisten nærmest bordet skrev ned ordet yrkesskade.
illustrations.prompt: At the wedding table in the Great Hall, the three aunts explain themselves to the Prince, who leans forward politely: the Long-Nosed Aunt taps her enormous nose, the Broad-Hipped Aunt pats her wide hips, and the Teary-Eyed Aunt has taken off her glasses and is wiping them on the white tablecloth. Behind the rope, the journalist nearest the table scribbles in a notebook. The Bride sits very still, looking down.
illustrations.caption: Journalisten nærmest bordet skrev ned ordet yrkesskade.
illustrations.alt: Ved bryllupsbordet forklarer de tre mostrene seg for prinsen: én peker på nesa, én klapper seg på hoftene, og én tørker brillene på duken. Bak tauet skriver en journalist i notatblokka si.

illustrations.anchor: Et sted langs veggen ble det tatt fire hundre bilder.
illustrations.prompt: In the Great Hall, the Prince has risen and holds the Bride's hand up beside him, facing the guests and the press along the wall, where a storm of camera flashes goes off. At the table the Queen looks down at the knitting in her lap and quietly slips it into her handbag. At the end of the table, the Teary-Eyed Aunt raises her glass towards the newlyweds, just a little.
illustrations.caption: «Så skal min kone aldri i sine dager måtte spinne eller veve eller sy.»
illustrations.alt: Prinsen står og holder bruden i hånda mens kameraene blitser. Dronningen legger stille strikketøyet ned i veska, og mosteren med de røde brillene løfter glasset mot bruden.
